event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Hot inflation, tech sold, defensives bid.
October CPI printed 0.4% m/m vs 0.30% fc and core 0.3% vs 0.20%, pushing Fed-hike odds to 100% for December and lifting the dollar 0.62% — that killed gold and semis while rate-certainty money hid in XLF and XLV. 16.5 on Nov 6 payrolls vs 6.5 fc keeps the rate-sensitivity intact.

INDICES — VIX 19.5, just above its 19.3 20-day MA. RSP -0.03%, DIA -0.31%, SPY -0.37%, QQQ -0.68%, IWM -0.68%. Small = large at -0.37%. QQQ is BELOW its 200-day MA — a CTA sell trigger. Biggest cross-asset move: TLT -1.32% was the cleanest shock, with GLD -2.68%.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SOXX at 2.0x was the only index drawing real attention while SPY printed just 0.79x and QQQ 0.73x — low-conviction drift, not accumulation. GXC exploded to 10.8x on a -1.17% move, a distribution signal in China names. Breadth: 247 adv / 250 dec, up/down volume 0.64, 69% above the 50-DMA but only 62% above the 200-DMA, 46 new 60d highs vs 9 lows. Participation confirms a defensive rotation — broad enough but leaders are bleeding.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLF Financials +0.52%, XLE Energy +0.44%, XLC Comms +0.37%, XLV Healthcare +0.29%, XLP Staples +0.15%, XLY Discretionary +0.03%, XLI Industrials -0.09%, XLRE Real Estate -0.13%, XLU Utilities -0.14%, XLB Materials -0.17%, XLK Technology -1.15%. Top industries: UNG +3.37%, FCG +1.61%; bottom: GDX -5.43%, SILJ -5.73%. Flows: XLV +$626mm (94p) and XLK +$607mm (94p) inflow, XLC -$1,018mm (2p) and XLF -$823mm (14p) outflow — XLF's price gain is short-covering, not conviction. Money is leaving comms and industrials for healthcare and tech. State: defensive risk-off.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 0.73 and IWM 0.44 show little protection buying despite CPI; QQQ skew +11.2% and ATM IV 24.7% is the bid. VIXEQ 44.1 vs VIX 19.5 — a 24-point gap, wide single-stock dispersion, a rotation tape not a macro one.

CROSS-ASSET — Dollar UUP +0.62% crushed metals: GLD -2.68%, SLV -3.45%, GDX -5.43%. Yields backed up on CPI with TLT -1.32%, IEF -0.86%. Next FOMC Dec 9; CME FedWatch shows hike 100.0%, Polimarket 4% for no change (5d -30pp).

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 57.7, Neutral. NVDA -5.47% on 3.1x volume — headlines cite a probe of Jensen Huang's ties to an alleged Chinese spy; PAAS -5.83%, LEN -5.37%. Momentum worst: XLK -13.94% 20d. Watch XLF (+0.52%) for the flows/price contradiction, SOXX (-0.12%, 2.0x vol) for the gamma-sensitive 200-DMA gap, and GDX (-5.43%) for silver stress.
